svg.title: Theme Customizer — Colors Tab — Customizer Panel at 1280x800
svg.desc: Color picker tab with controls for primary, secondary, accent, background, and foreground colors. Color swatches with hex inputs and visual pickers. WCAG AA contrast on all text.
